en.t: The days passed by in emptiness.

units.source_text: 每逢七日的佛事都很隆重，

en.t: Each seventh-day Buddhist service was held with great solemnity,
and the rites and offerings were lavish beyond compare.

units.source_text: 然而名分所限，薰中纳言未便改穿丧服。

en.t: Yet because propriety limited his position, Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, could not properly change into mourning clothes.

units.source_text: 于是大女公子生前亲近的几个侍女，就穿了深黑色的丧服。

en.t: So several gentlewomen who had been close to the elder princess in life put on deep black mourning robes.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言无意中看到了，吟诗曰：

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, happened to see them and recited this poem:
